test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states became the first state in India to provide 100% tap water supply in rural areas in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goa became the first 'Har Ghar Jal State' in India with 100% tap water connections in October 2020.**
 
• Goa has become the** first state in India to provide 100 per cent tap water connections in the rural areas covering 2.30 lakh households.**
 
• The** Jal Jeevan Mission** of the Central Government** aims to provide piped water to all rural households by 2024.**
 
• **Under Jal Jeevan Mission, it is mandatory that 5 persons in every village**, especially women, must be trained in using field test kits to test the water.
 
• Currently,** Gajendra Singh Shekhawat is a Union Jal Shakti Minister.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Goa is the smallest state in India.**
 
• The state has the** highest per capita income in India.**
 
• **Portugal ruled Goa for almost 450 years**.
 
• **Goa celebrates two independence days.**
 
 
• India became an independent country, free from British rule, on **15th August 1947.**
 
• **Goa celebrates this second independence day on 19th December** every year as it's get's liberated from Portuguese rule in **1961**.
 
• Chief minister: **Pramod Sawant. (June 2022)**
 
• Governor of Goa: **Shri P.S. Sreedharan Pillai. (June 2022)**
